# jobs: the policy

The jobs folder's agent: what it does on its own, and when. Each rule is off, watch or do (watch: everything runs,
the cards are marked "would have shown"). Rung draft: it writes, you send. It never sends, submits or signs in, in
any mode. Change a rule's words here; the order does not matter.

- [watch, draft] clock: 07:30 find postings that fit me.md on public careers pages and job boards, signed out; the top ones get their folder in applications/ and a card
- [watch, draft] clock: 08:00 find 10 people in SF who fit sf-trip/approach.md (from Nov 26: people who fit, anywhere), public pages only; each a file in people/ and one card to keep or drop
- [watch, draft] people: when a person is kept → the draft from their variant, and a card to send it yourself
- [watch, draft] clock: 09:00 a follow-up draft for each person sent a message 5 days ago with no reply, once
- [watch, draft] people: when a person replies or you meet → sf-trip/plan.md; after a meeting, "how did it go?" and a thank-you draft
- [watch] clock: Sunday 18:00 the week's lesson in lessons/, one card
- [watch, draft] folder: a new file in resume/ → read it into me.md's facts and redo fit.md of the open applications
